# braidworks run

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Call ONE weaver capability directly (no routing). For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/).

```text
usage: braidworks run WEAVER CAPABILITY --have TYPE=VALUE [options]

Call ONE weaver capability directly (no routing).

positional arguments:
  weaver                weaver id (see `braidworks weavers`).
  capability            capability id.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --have TYPE=VALUE     an input strand; repeatable. Broadcast onto every --in-file row.
  --in-file PATH        batch input: a CSV/TSV with type-id columns, or (with --in-type) one value
                        per line. Use '-' for stdin.
  --in-type TYPE        treat --in-file as one VALUE per line of this strand type.
  --want TYPE[,TYPE…]   restrict outputs (default: all the capability produces).
  --param NAME=VALUE    a capability parameter (repeatable).
  --format {human,json,jsonl,tsv,csv}
                        output format (default: human).

Advanced:
  --backend BACKEND     backend name (required only if the capability has >1).
  --only SOURCES        restrict to these source ids (comma/space separated).
  --strict              exit non-zero if any input is unresolved or needs review.
  --archive PATH        save a self-contained JSON run archive (new file; no overwrite).

examples:
  braidworks run uniprot resolve_protein --have protein.query=P04637
  braidworks run pdbe list_structures --have protein.uniprot.accession=P04637 \
      --format json
```
